title: Pip and the Thank-You Seasons Picture
moral: Saying thank you to the ones who help us makes everyone's heart feel warm.
description: Nana Hoot helps Pip, Tumble and Hazel all year long, so the friends decide to paint her a giant thank-you picture of every season! But first they have to remember spring, summer, autumn and winter, with lots of SPLOOSHes, sneezes and one very silly snowman BONK. Learn the four seasons in this funny animated story about gratitude, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Hi friends! Look at Clover Wood today! The leaves are red, orange and yellow. Swish, swish, swish, they float down!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Tumble! Nana Hoot helps us ALL year long. Let's say a super-duper big THANK YOU!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Yes, please! But... how?

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: BOING! Tee-hee-hee! Let's paint her a picture of every season!
Hazel the hedgehog is new in Clover Wood. She has never seen a whole year here!

narration.text: So the friends set up a giant paper. Big enough for an elephant!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Pip, how many seasons are there?

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Easy-peasy! There are... seventeen seasons! And a pancake season!
Tee-hee! Silly Pip! There are FOUR seasons. Let's count them! One, two, three, four!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Four boxes for four seasons! Spring, summer, autumn and winter!

narration.text: Pip and Tumble told Hazel all about it. First comes SPRING! It gets warmer, and baby birds hatch. Tweet, tweet!
Last spring, Nana Hoot helped them plant seeds. Then Tumble filled his trunk with water and...
SPLOOOSH! Oopsie-trunk! He watered Pip instead of the seeds! Drip, drip, drip!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Look, my dears! Pop, pop, pop! Flowers grow in spring!

narration.text: Next comes SUMMER! The sun shines big and bright, and the days are long.
Is summer hot or cold? What do you think?
HOT! Yes! You're so smart!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Nana let us sit under her big umbrella-rella-brella-thingy! And she made cool lemonade!
But Nana got so cosy, she fell asleep. Snore... SNORE... HONK! Tumble's trunk woke her up!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I'm awake! I'm awake!

narration.text: Then comes AUTUMN. That's right now! In autumn, the leaves change colour and fall down, down, down.
The friends raked a big leaf pile. AH-CHOO! Tumble sneezed it away. Whoooosh! They raked again. AH... AH-CHOO! Whoooosh!
The third time, Hazel jumped right in. BOING! Out she popped, with leaves stuck on all her prickles!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Tee-hee-hee! I'm a leaf hedgehog! What colours are my leaves, friends?
Red, orange and yellow! Hooray, you got it!
Pip shouted, after autumn comes summer again! Nope, silly Pip! After autumn comes WINTER!
Winter is cold, cold, COLD! Brrr! Sometimes soft white snow falls down.
Last winter, Tumble zoomed down Snowy Hill on Nana's sledge. Wheeee! BONK! Right into the snowman!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oopsie-trunk! Now I'm a snow-elephant!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Come inside for warm cocoa, my snowy dears!

narration.text: Back in the meadow, they painted all four seasons. A pink flower for spring. A big yellow sun for summer. Orange leaves for autumn.
Tumble dipped his trunk in blue paint for winter snowflakes. Dab, dab, dab... HONK!
Pip stepped back to look and... whoops! He slipped in the paint and got a blue nose!

narration.text: That evening, the friends carried the picture to Nana Hoot's tree. Knock, knock!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Thank you, Nana, for helping us in spring, summer, autumn AND winter!
Nana's glasses slipped down her beak. She looked at the picture... upside down!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Oh my! Snow falling UP? Hoo-hoo-HOO! What a wonderful thank-you!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! You're the best Nana in every season!

narration.text: Let's remember! How many seasons are there?
FOUR! Spring, summer, autumn and winter!
Which season is cold, with soft white snow?
WINTER! Brrr! You remembered! Super-duper!

narration.text: Nana Hoot hung the picture over her fire, right where she could see it every day.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Thank YOU, my dears. Your picture will make me smile in every season.

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: And thank you for my first autumn, friends! I can't wait for my first winter!
Then everyone sipped warm cocoa and giggled. Tee-hee-hee! Hoo-hoo-HOO! Saying thank you made all their hearts feel warm.
